title: Prophecies Against Jeroboam and Rehoboam

questions.question: Who fell sick, prompting Jeroboam to send his wife to a prophet?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:1 (ESV): "At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick."

questions.question: Who did Jeroboam's wife go to see?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:2 (ESV): "...Arise, and disguise yourself... and go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there..."

questions.question: How did Jeroboam's wife disguise herself?
options: So she would not be known as the wife of Jeroboam
questions.correctAnswer: So she would not be known as the wife of Jeroboam
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:2 (ESV): "...disguise yourself, that it not be known that you are the wife of Jeroboam..."

questions.question: What did Ahijah predict would happen to Jeroboam's house?
options: God would bring disaster and cut off every male
questions.correctAnswer: God would bring disaster and cut off every male
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:10 (ESV): "therefore behold, I will bring harm upon the house of Jeroboam and will cut off from Jeroboam every male..."

questions.question: Who attacked Jerusalem during Rehoboam's reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:25 (ESV): "In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem."

questions.question: Why could Ahijah not see?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:4 (ESV): "...Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were dim because of his age."

questions.question: What happened to the child Abijah when his mother entered the city?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:17 (ESV): "Then Jeroboam's wife arose and departed and came to Tirzah. And as she came to the threshold of the house, the child died."

questions.question: Why was Abijah the only one of Jeroboam's house to be properly buried?
options: Because in him there was found something pleasing to the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Because in him there was found something pleasing to the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:13 (ESV): "...for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found something pleasing to the LORD..."

questions.question: What did Shishak take from the temple?
options: The treasures of the house of the LORD and the king's house, including gold shields
questions.correctAnswer: The treasures of the house of the LORD and the king's house, including gold shields
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:26 (ESV): "He took away the treasures of the house of the LORD and the treasures of the king's house... He also took away all the shields of gold that Solomon had made."

questions.question: What did Rehoboam make to replace the gold shields?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:27 (ESV): "And King Rehoboam made in their place shields of bronze..."

questions.question: How long did Jeroboam reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:20 (ESV): "And the time that Jeroboam reigned was twenty-two years..."

questions.question: How long did Rehoboam reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:21 (ESV): "...He reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem..."

questions.question: Who was Rehoboam's mother?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:21 (ESV): "...His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite."

questions.question: What wicked practice was explicitly mentioned as being in the land of Judah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:24 (ESV): "and there were also male cult prostitutes in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations..."

questions.question: Where was Jeroboam's capital at the time of his wife's return?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:17 (ESV): "Then Jeroboam's wife arose and departed and came to Tirzah..."

key_verse_text: The LORD will strike Israel as a reed is shaken in the water, and root up Israel out of this good land that he gave to their fathers and scatter them beyond the Euphrates... (ESV)
